overview_description.description: Auxos develops software that creates AI customer models based on real survey respondents for specific target segments. The platform builds 1:1 digital twins of individuals in an ideal customer profile and links each clone to grounded interview data. Product, marketing, and research teams use these simulated audiences to run quantitative surveys, test messaging and creative, and explore pricing scenarios. Auxos also supports validation of onboarding flows and product concepts before launch. The system delivers both numerical results and structured qualitative reasoning, allowing teams to examine underlying decision drivers. Its workflow includes defining the audience, recruiting and interviewing matching customers, and then deploying always-on simulations for ongoing research.
